paper_title: Search for dark matter particle interactions with electron final states with DarkSide-50
notes: Paper places 90% C.L. limits on axioelectric coupling g_Ae for ALP masses between 0.03 keV/c^2 and 0.2 keV/c^2 (i.e. ~30-200 eV), assuming rho_DM=0.3 GeV/cm^3 (Standard Halo Model). Also constrains dark photon kinetic mixing kappa, DM-electron cross section, and sterile neutrino mixing. Numerical limit values are only available in Fig. 2 (exclusion plot); no data table is provided in the text, so no numerical (mass, coupling) pairs could be reliably extracted.
